g.text: mmap(addr, length, prot, flags, fd, offset)
Memory is allocated using Mman::mmap() into a shared memory region used as a ring buffer. An unmap callback ensures cleanup.
Creates and manages a shared memory ring buffer. Allocates via Mman::mmap(), ensures cleanup with munmap. Handles file creation, naming, and permissions.
Abstracts POSIX memory management. mmap() maps files into memory, munmap() releases it. All errors propagated to caller.
